NONDISCLOSURE AGREEMENT
For Case No.: ER-2026-0291
(To Access Confidential Information)

I, Greg R. Meyer, have reviewed the Commission's Rule at 20 CSR 4240-2.135 on the 7" day of
October, 2026.

Ihave requested review of the confidential information produced in Case No. ER-2026-0291 on
behalf of the Midwest Energy Consumers Group (“MECG”).

Thereby certify that:

(a) Only employees of a party that are acting as an expert for that party or that have been
retained for this case as an outside expert for that party may receive confidential
information;

(b) An employee is a person in the service of his or her employer whose services are
controllable by the employer.

(c) Lam an outside expert for MECG retained to provide expert consultation or testimony
in this docket; and

(d) I have read and agree to abide by the Commission's Rule at 20 CSR 4240-2.135.

Dated this 7" day of October, 2026.

0 Wiper

NONDISCLOSURE AGREEMENT
For Case No.: ER-2026-0291
(To Access Highly Confidential Information)

I, Greg R. Meyer, have reviewed the Commission's Rule at 20 CSR 4240-2.135 on the 7 day of
October, 2026.

Ihave requested review of the highly confidential information produced in Case
No. ER-2026-0291 on behalf of the Midwest Energy Consumers Group (“MECG”).

Thereby certify that:

(a) Only certain persons may receive Highly Confidential information. These persons
include outside attorneys of record for a party in the case and in-house attorneys of record
for the Company. Such persons also include outside consultants retained by a party in
this case and Company experts and/or employees who intend to file testimony in this
docket. Persons authorized to receive highly confidential information, other than the
above-referenced attorneys or Commission Staff and Office of Public Counsel employees
must submit this form in order receive highly confidential information;

(b) Lam an outside consultant retained by MECG and fall within the category of persons
authorized to receive highly confidential information specified in paragraph (a) above;
and

(c) [have read and agree to abide by the Commission's Rule at 20 CSR 4240-2.135 and all
terms of the Protective Order issued by the Commission in this docket.

Dated this 7" day of October, 2026.

Klay KW igen
